3240-3899-6277-6462.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1770-2226-2950.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-2950.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aven Surveyor by paying its mana cost.
When Aven Surveyor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1418-2226-8306.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-8306.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Keymaster Rogue by paying its mana cost.
When Keymaster Rogue enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1981-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-6720.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

529-4186-6965-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

339-677-1251-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

129-1409-3755-4785.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

4644-7203-7791.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Brigid
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Brigid
Repeat.

647-3259-4053-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-4053-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
647-3259-4053-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6633-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6633-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-6791.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7338.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Putrid Pals.
When Putrid Pals dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

465-4605-5686-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1475-4050-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Repeat.

719-2366-5147-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-5147-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-3490-4659-5070.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4659-5070.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

625-1978-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
625-1978-6410.description:
Cause Howlsquad Heavy to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2173-2292-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-2292-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-2292-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1274-2685-3197-4321.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2685-3197-4321.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-1849-2457-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2921-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-2921-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-643-647-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

803-1429-2034-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-2034-5402.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

997-2459-5220-5683.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Rograkh and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

64-1987-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
64-1987-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

2665-2743-5904.notablePrerequisites: Adric does not have summoning sickness.
2665-2743-5904.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Progenitor Mimic's trigger.
Resolve both triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2867-3967-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

1235-3327-3719.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo is one of your commanders.
You have sacrificed a number of artifacts and/or creatures this turn equal to the number of times you've cast
1235-3327-3719.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When the Ruthless Technomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Ruthless Technomancer and create two Treasure artifact tokens.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Activate the Ruthless Technomancer token by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 8.

914-1170-2556-2596-4074.notablePrerequisites:
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1170-2556-2596-4074.description:
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, copying Living Death.
Resolve the copy of Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Resolve Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Mnemonic Wall and Dockside Extortionist enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
Invasion of Tolvada // The Broken Sky

1031-1749-2650-3556-4074.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra's ability this turn.
1031-1749-2650-3556-4074.description:
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Arcavios.
Invasion of Arcavios triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Invocation of the Founders.
Activate Chandra's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Invocation of the Founders.
Chandra and Invocation of the Founders trigger, copying Flicker twice, with one copy targeting Chandra and the other targeting Invasion of Tolvada.
Resolve the first Flicker copy, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the second Flicker copy, blinking Invasion of Tolvada.
When Invasion of Tolvada enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Hexmage to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Invocation of the Founders, causing it to enter the battlefield as Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

880-3875-4862.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Omnath trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

878-1605-3059.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus, deal damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent, and create three Treasure tokens.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-4658-5070.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
314-4658-5070.description:
Cast Soul of Eternity by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Soul of Eternity enters the battlefield, triggering Angelic Chorus, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Vito triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

231-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one land.
231-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {2}{W} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand.
If it has not triggered this turn, Tameshi's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Tameshi's second ability, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Play any land from your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
